in_marathi.name: Anokhika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anokhika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anokhika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anokha’ which means ‘rare’ or ‘unique’. This name is often given to a child who is considered a precious and rare gift.
